key_findings: Cyclic PnCS1 analogues inhibit NaV subtypes (NaV1.1, 1.3, 1.6, 1.7) with no activity at NaV1.8 and reduce OD1- and PGE2-induced nociception in vivo.
PnCS1[R6E] was analgesic in vivo despite inactivity at NaV channels in vitro, suggesting off-target analgesic mechanisms.
